comment: Menu item names checked against the maker's manuals at github.com/patheros/PathSetManuals. Two names differ from the manual and the module is followed: it prints Compass Display where the manual says Compass Display Mode, Accidentals Mode where the entry used to say Accidental Mode, and Wave Arms? where the manual says Wave Arms. Only Quantum Compass and Orchestrator add anything to the right-click menu; WarpDrive and Shuttle add nothing.
